title: validation producer rejected Markdown-formatted overlap paths
symptom: The official validation operation returned OFFICIAL_TRANSITION_NOT_OBSERVED with outer retry 0 before candidate validation or persistence.

evidence.producerError: Prior Validation Overlap path must be a normalized relative path
evidence.preflight: VALIDATE_SLICE slice-03 was legal; no candidate mutation was persisted; outer retry remained 0
evidence.finalSemanticResponse: status=BLOCKED; persistenceSummary reported that no Validation Attempt, Effective Validation Base, task-row update, or candidate publication was persisted

rootCause: parseOverlapPathSection split the Paths value on comma-space and passed Markdown code spans, including backticks, directly to normalizedRelative. The path normalizer therefore saw a different string from the physical task-relative claim and rejected it before the validation bundle could be generated.
correction: The producer now accepts only an exact comma-separated list of raw relative claims or an exact comma-separated list of balanced Markdown path carriers, extracts the carrier values before strict normalizedRelative validation, rejects mixed/ambiguous carriers, and continues deriving physical targets and hashes through the existing validation producer.
whyCodeVsPrompt: The model had already made the semantic overlap decision and persisted the correct physical claims. Removing Markdown presentation delimiters and validating the resulting path list is deterministic serialization; adding another prose warning would leave the recurring mechanical boundary model-owned.

regression.test: deterministic runner evidence serializer emits physical task-relative SHA-256 tuples
coverage: balanced Markdown overlap path carriers produce the same physical task-relative bundle
mixed/ambiguous overlap path carriers are rejected without mutating the task
realpath identity and strict candidate validation remain covered by the existing producer/candidate assertions

liveReplay: pending fresh replay after this functional edit
workflowProgress: Case A and Case C passed before this edit; Case B reached slice-03 validation and stopped at the producer boundary
